title: RobustBotDetection: Reliability-Guided Expert Routing for Multimodal Twitter Bot Detection under Informative Modality Missingness
description: Reproducible implementation of a leakage-controlled multimodal social bot detection pipeline with modality-specific experts, validation-guided routing, informative-missingness auditing, pattern-label debiasing, probability calibration, robustness stress tests, statistical inference, identifier-overlap auditing, and overlap-excluded TwiBot-20 validation.
